checks.ref:
command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
outside=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v "^$change/" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$outside" ] || { echo "$outside"; echo "the fix-specs stage revises only files under $change/ - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^fix-specs#/ { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
review="$change/review-specs.md"
hunks=$(git diff -U0 "$since" -- "$review" | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -vE '^(---|\+\+\+) ' || true)
removed=$(printf '%s\n' "$hunks" | grep -E '^-' | grep -vxF -- '-- Status: open' || true)
added=$(printf '%s\n' "$hunks" | grep -E '^\+' | grep -vE '^\+(- Status: |- Resolution: |  +[^ ])' || true)
[ -z "$removed$added" ] || { printf '%s\n' "$removed" "$added" | grep .; echo "only the '- Status:' lines and the new '- Resolution:' lines (continuation lines indented) of $review may change - restore the rest with: git checkout $since -- $review, then re-apply the statuses"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R4 revision left a THEN clause with no possible assertion: specs/date-selection/spec.md:99-100 'Pick a date in a later month' says 'THEN it shows March 2026 with 8 March selected and marked as today', but tasks.md:41 (6.2) now runs this scenario on a rendered AppShell, lists only `queryByRole("dialog")`, the calendar heading text, the bar's `<time dateTime>` and the New York row text as its checks, and states 'No step asserts `aria-*` or focus'. In the DOM the selected/today marks exist only as `aria-selected` / `aria-current` (design.md D6), and design.md D8 says jsdom tests 'never assert keyboard handling, `aria-*` states…'. The step can only be a no-op, the 'vacuous step' harm R4 itself named. Fix cheaply: drop the 'selected and marked as today' clause from that scenario (it is covered by 'The calendar opens on the pinned date' via renderHook `isSelected`/`isToday` and by E2E 'Names and marks'), or have task 6.2 assert it through a hook-driven step or another jsdom-safe fact it names.
